summary: Exa's billing documentation says new accounts receive $20 in free credits on signup, while Free Tier accounts receive $10 in free credits each month. No payment method is required. The free tier covers all endpoints, with published rate limits including 10 Search QPS and 50 Agent concurrency; requests stop when the balance reaches zero.
claim_steps: Create an Exa account to receive the $20 signup credits.
Use the Free Tier, which adds $10 in credits each month without requiring a payment method.
Use the credits before the balance reaches zero or add credits separately to continue making requests.
